raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The silver filter keeps only status='POSTED' and drops the 24 REVERSAL rows. Their originals (orig_txn_id 904142-904802, in the latest batches) are still POSTED, so the reversed purchases stay in silver and inflate gold for the most recent days. Silver should exclude POSTED transactions that have a matching REVERSAL row.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions rv WHERE rv.status = 'REVERSAL' AND rv.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id);"}}
